intervals.label: operating
intervals.note: Spring 2016 is the earliest data-taking documented in the first GlueX result paper; commissioning runs may have preceded it, so this is an upper bound on the start of operation, not the start of construction.
intervals.quote: The data were collected in the spring of 2016 utilizing the newly upgraded Continuous Electron Beam Accelerator Facility (CEBAF) at Jefferson Lab.

placements.note: Hall D identity from the JLab Hall D page and the J/psi paper; start = first documented GlueX data (spring 2016).
placements.quote: The data were collected by the GlueX experiment located in Hall D at Jefferson Lab during 2016 and 2017

solenoid_field.quote: A 2-T solenoidal magnet surrounds the drift chambers used for charged-particle tracking.

subsystems.quote: The energy and arrival time of beam photons are tagged using a scintillator hodoscope and a scintillating fiber array.
subsystems.value: Photon beam tagging (scintillator hodoscope and scintillating fiber array), pair spectrometer and triplet polarimeter

subsystems.quote: Electromagnetic showers are reconstructed in a cylindrical scintillating fiber calorimeter inside the magnet and a lead-glass array downstream.
subsystems.value: Electromagnetic calorimetry: cylindrical scintillating fiber calorimeter inside the magnet and a lead-glass array downstream

summary.plain: A hermetic detector in Jefferson Lab Hall D that tracks charged particles in a 2-tesla solenoid and measures photons and particle flight times, built to reconstruct complete photoproduction reactions.
summary.technical: GlueX beamline and detector: tagged linearly polarised photon beam; central straw-tube drift chamber and six packages of planar cathode-strip/drift-wire chambers in a 2 T solenoid; cylindrical scintillating-fibre barrel calorimeter inside the magnet and a lead-glass forward calorimeter; time-of-flight and a later DIRC for kaon identification.

technology.quote: Charged-particle tracks from interactions in the central target are analyzed in a solenoidal field using a central straw-tube drift chamber and six packages of planar chambers with cathode strips and drift wires.
technology.value: Large-acceptance, nearly hermetic photoproduction spectrometer: tagged linearly polarised photon beam, central straw-tube drift chamber and planar chambers in a solenoid, barrel and forward calorimeters, time-of-flight
